behavior_constraints: New `export` subcommand accepts `<pipeline_yaml>` and the flags --sort-by, --descending, --format, --filter

Column order is: experiment_id, parameter names sorted alphabetically, then for each metric (sorted alphabetically regardless of objective) the raw `<metric>` followed by `<metric>_norm`, then composite_score, then pareto_optimal
`<metric>_norm` uses report's min-max normalization (inverted for minimize objectives, 0.5 for constant metrics), empty for metrics with objective `report`

`pareto_optimal` is `yes` if the experiment is Pareto-optimal across all objective metrics (direction-aware raw values; dominated if another is at least as good on every objective and strictly better on one), else `no`; all experiments are Pareto-optimal when only report metrics exist
Parameter values are extracted from the experiment ID using the pipeline's parameter definitions
Raw metric values formatted to stored precision; normalized values use 4 decimal places; composite_score uses the same 4-decimal-place value as report, empty when no objective metrics
`--format csv` (default) emits comma-separated header + data rows
`--format json` emits a JSON array of objects with keys matching column headers in the same row order post-sort; numeric values as numbers, empty cells as null
`--format markdown` emits a GitHub-flavored Markdown table with header row, `---` separator row (parameter and experiment_id columns left-aligned `---`, all others `---:`), and data rows
`--sort-by <column_name>` sorts by an exact header name (including `_norm` columns); default sort is alphabetical by experiment_id
affected_prior: reportPipeline (min-max normalization and composite_score computation reused)
entities.summary: Add an `export` subcommand that emits a sorted, filtered, multi-format (csv/json/markdown) table of experiment results with raw and normalized metric columns, composite_score, and Pareto-optimality.

instruction_head:
Add an `export` command that outputs experiment results as a structured table to stdout.

`./mlpipe export <pipeline_yaml> [flags]`

**Columns** (in this exact order): `experiment_id`, then all parameter names from the pipeline definition (sorted alphabetically), then for each metric name across all stages (sorted alphabetically, regardless of objective): both the raw value column (`<metric>`) and immediately after it a normalized value column (`<metric>_norm`), then `composite_score`, then `par
